P11.1: Six separate named public schemas from API design section 4.7, with exact attribute sets, explicit indexes, a coarse ocean-basin allowlist and bounded readonly publication options.
Independent read-only Rabdi adapter using pinned @arkiv-network/sdk 1.0.1, expected creator and current owner, creation flags and expiration.
Bounded task-index lookup filtered by schema, task and wallet. Reports query block, observed head, lag and truncation.

live_read_only.note: The query checks a historical H04 task ID against the new P11 schema. The result establishes RPC compatibility with the query. No P11 transaction was sent and no P11 record was read back.
